audit.why: Early heavily Pantheon-favored (Malzahar has no peel pre-6), mid even with Nether Grasp online, side/teamfight flips to Malzahar at two items. Page prose reflects this; only the full-layer chart sides were blanket 'Skill'.
Spikes: Pantheon L2 (W stun), L3 full kit, first item Eclipse; Malzahar 6 (Nether Grasp 140s rank 1) and especially two items (waveclear + Zhonya's). spikes[0..3] all present and accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; key interactions (Q silence 6s CD denying W/E casts, R channel vs W stun, R cancelling Pantheon's E channel) under-stated; dos/donts bodies were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Malzahar Q (6s CD, 900 range) silences — Pantheon cannot W or E during it. Nether Grasp 140/110/80 is point-and-click suppression that cancels Pantheon's E channel; QSS breaks it. Malzahar passive gives damage reduction + CC immunity until poked off — strip it before committing W.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3 — point-and-click suppression that also cancels your E channel; never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. - His Q silence cycles every 6s and his E every 11s — trade in the gap between casts. - Your E (22s) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Every step to a minion eats a Q — and the same poke strips his passive shield, so the spear both wins the trade math and opens the W all-in.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At 2 he has zero peel and no ult — pop his passive shield with Q first, then W-stun the next step-up and take the trade for free.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-core he shoves and chips from 900 range with Q and Voidlings — walk up only in the 6-second gap after his Q silence is spent.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Two items flip it: perma-clear, Zhonya's and passive shields make him dive-proof — you become the opener for your team, not his executioner.
